decisions.question: Which controls on a sheet keep a paper fill once fields lose theirs: ghost buttons, segmented controls, badges or none?
decisions.recommended: Every control drops its fill, except any the owner sees a rule run through badly in the look round.
decisions.alternative: Fields, segmented controls and badges drop the fill, and ghost buttons keep it.
decisions.answer: Nothing filled: every control on a sheet drops its paper fill, and every button's text sits on a rule.

decisions.question: Should each diet get an icon, picked in the backoffice like the meal categories, so the Diets list matches Meals?
decisions.recommended: Yes: each diet tag gets an icon set in the backoffice, and the menu shows it like a meal icon.
decisions.alternative: No: Diets show as a two-column list with counts and no icons.
decisions.answer: Each diet tag gets an icon picked in the backoffice, like the meal categories.

decisions.question: Which three meals do the phone search panel Try pills show, and in what order?
decisions.recommended: The three meals with the most recipes, shown in the order of the Meals list (Breakfast before Lunch before Dinner).
decisions.alternative: Always Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner, whatever their recipe counts.
decisions.answer: Always Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner, in that order, whatever their recipe counts.

decisions.question: When sheets merge, how are the old sheets (At a glance, Ingredients, Instructions, Nutrition) labelled inside the merged sheet?
decisions.recommended: Each part gets a caps kicker heading inside the sheet, and the merged sheet keeps at most one green tab label.
decisions.alternative: Each part keeps its own green tab label, placed inside the merged sheet.
decisions.answer: Each part gets a caps kicker heading inside the sheet; the merged sheet keeps at most one green tab label.

decisions.question: How is the variant page merged sheet of Ingredients, Instructions and Nutrition laid out at desktop width?
decisions.recommended: Ingredients and Instructions side by side, Nutrition across the full width below; stacked in that order on a phone.
decisions.alternative: All three stacked in one column at every width.
decisions.answer: Ingredients and Instructions side by side, Nutrition full width below; stacked in that order on a phone.

decisions.question: The local Home page has no blocks, so its look was never reviewed; is Home in phase 1?
decisions.recommended: Home gets only the site-wide changes (header, controls, spacing) in phase 1, and its blocks are reviewed in a later phase.
decisions.alternative: Home blocks are seeded locally and reviewed now, in phase 1.
decisions.answer: Home gets only the site-wide changes in phase 1; its blocks get their own review in a later phase.

decisions.question: On the Recipes page, the applied-filter chips and the phone Filters button lie on the desk; which sheet do they move onto?
decisions.recommended: The Recipes page top sheet, under Sort and View, the way the recipe page tools sheet holds its pills.
decisions.alternative: A slim tools sheet of their own above the results.
decisions.answer: A slim sheet of their own above the results grid.
